DHAKA, Feb 3, 2023 (BSS) - Ambiente 2023, an internationally unique platform for consumer goods, began today at Frankfurt, Germany.

Some 55 Bangladeshi companies have taken part to showcase their products at the five-day leading global consumer goods show, said a press release here today.
